acceptance: A lane build that removes a history-carrying comment group without adding its text to its package's archive page is named by the floor (red first), in shadow a WARN and in enforce a correction
The rule is commentaudit.RemovedHistoryAcrossDiff + UnrecordedHistory, with no second copy
fix: Add a build-floor check beside comment_floor (go/internal/core/comment_floor.go) that runs commentaudit.RemovedHistoryAcrossDiff then commentaudit.UnrecordedHistory over the worktree diff against its base, staged shadow then enforce via policy.json like comment_floor; or have the build phase run `commentaudit history` automatically before handoff.
routed_reason: lane triage (cycle 2002) escalate_block: protected-surface: go/internal/core/build_floor_reviewer.go — control-plane changes go through the console route (operator-gated), not lane top_n
summary: The commit gate now refuses a console change that removes a history-carrying comment group unless the change adds it to docs/history/code-comments (ADR-0115). Loop lanes ship with --class cycle and never pass through the commit gate, so a lane that deletes history-bearing code still lands it unrecorded.
title: Loop lanes can remove history-carrying comments without recording them in the history archive (lane part)
